name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with legs straight and stacked, forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Brace your stomach and lift your hips until your body is straight from head to feet.
Rest your top hand on your hip or reach it to the ceiling.
Hold without letting your hips drop, then lower slowly and switch sides.
cues: Hips up, body in a straight line
Stack feet, or stagger them for balance

common_mistakes.fix: Push the bottom hip up; bend the bottom knee to make it easier

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbow placed too far from the body
common_mistakes.fix: Set the elbow right under the shoulder before lifting

common_mistakes.mistake: Rolling the chest toward the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders and hips stacked, chest facing forward
